variants.name: 01-classic-ocean
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE finished standalone portrait 4:5 wallet QR sharing image, high fidelity clean typography. This is an image sent to WhatsApp, NOT a phone/app screenshot. Reference image 1 is the chosen Ocean Frame design: keep its navy outer frame and large WHITE ROUNDED RECTANGLE inside. Reference image 2 is the actual Socially captain brand icon: place this icon INSIDE THE EXACT CENTER of the QR in a small white-backed tile, approximately 12% of the QR width, with modest white padding. Do not replace logo with a boat or Solana mark. Keep Socially brand lockup above the card.
Required refinements: crisp sharply pointed square QR modules, straight edges, sharp square finder patterns, very simple visually open chunky QR pattern, navy modules on pure white, no rounded dots, no gradients inside QR, no ornamental code shapes. QR is illustrative concept art, not a working payment code. Generous white quiet zone. The QR is the main focus.
Typography: elegant Cormorant Garamond-like navy serif title 'Receive on Solana'; clean Inter-like secondary line 'Scan to send to my wallet'. Address label exactly 'Wallet Address:'; address exactly '2xv2aWMUEesXsbTwFwQcxNrJn4HebPVBCrYihQ8K3Zvg'. IMPORTANT: the COMPLETE address must fit ON ONE SINGLE LINE below label, with NO wrapping, NO ellipsis, NO truncation. Use a restrained readable monospaced font small enough to fit the card's inner width; 44 characters in one line, adjust type size instead of splitting. Card must be wide enough.
Bottom note EXACTLY: 'This address is for Solana assets only.' Remove old 'Send only SOL and Solana tokens' wording everywhere. Single small Solana network emblem may sit near note, but not inside center logo. Background navy #173652, text ink #102C46, white card, icy blue subtle details. Rounded outer white card, squared QR. No copy controls, no buttons, no status bar, no app UI. No extra slogans or text. Five versions belong to the same family; preserve these requirements in this variation. Faithful refinement: centered captain + SOCIALLY lockup on navy above white panel, subtle contour lines in outer frame and single tiny compass at upper right. White panel with 32px-equivalent rounded corners. Centered title and QR. Thin light-blue rules above address and footer. Address single line at roughly 21px on ~1100px-wide image. Quiet premium Ocean Frame.
